about: The pages each desk tool made on the desk server needs: a closed list per tool, as data, so any caller that sends a desk to the server sends the same pages the laptop's link sends.
A path here is a path in the desk folder, forward slashes. A name argument is read as the value itself and each [[name]] in it, and only a page name (lower case letters, digits and dashes) is kept.

narrow: a writer sends base, every seat page in seat_pages, the page of each name it names in each of page_folders, and its own files. In a template, {key} is the argument's value, which must be a page name, and {key:day} is the day the argument's moment starts with; an entry whose template cannot be filled sends nothing.

wide: a desk-wide tool sends every plain file in the desk's celorus/ folder that is UTF-8 text, never the rest of the folder that holds the desk, but nothing whose path has a part that starts with a dot, save the dot paths named for it exactly: its dot_files, a file named exactly as in dot_names inside celorus/ when no other part of its path starts with a dot, a spare file (spare) in one of its spares_in folders, and of the files directly in celorus/.views/ whose names do not start with a dot, those its views word gives (all, none, or dated: those dated within a day of the call's date, its taken_at or today). Nothing in a folder inside celorus/.views/ is sent. Beside celorus/ it sends only the files the desk's sent items (the pages the check reads under celorus/ whose type is sent) name in their file: lines, where the engine's check looks for them: each joined as the check joins it, and sent only when it is a plain file in the desk folder, outside celorus/, never written in full, with no part that starts with a dot and no part a disk may read as another name (the link's ODD_NAME), on a path the desk server takes; one that is not text is passed over.

layout_3: on a seat's graph (desk.md says layout_version 3) the call sends a firm folder: the seat's desk under seats/<its folder's name>/ and the firm's common space under common/. A narrow path under celorus/ is sent from the common space when it is one of common_pages or under one of common_folders; from the graph's own celorus/ when it names no folder; else from each of the graph's parts. Every narrow call also sends narrow_common. A desk-wide call sends the seat's desk as a desk is sent, the seat's folder standing for the desk folder (its celorus/, its dot paths and the files the seat's own sent items name), and the whole common space but its dot paths.
